improved_life_tap.name: Improved Life Tap
improved_life_tap.text: Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by {0}%.

suppression.name: Suppression
suppression.text: Improves your chance to hit by {0}% and reduces all threat you generate by {1}%.

improved_corruption.name: Improved Corruption
improved_corruption.text: Reduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by {0} sec and increases the damage it deals by {1}%.

malediction.name: Malediction
malediction.text: Increases all periodic damage done by your Warlock spells by {0}%.

soul_harvesting.name: Soul Harvesting
soul_harvesting.text: You gain Soul Harvest for {0} sec if a victim is killed while afflicted with your Drain Soul. Soul Harvest allows your Mana to regenerate at {1}% of normal speed while you are casting spells, and grants a {2}% increase to your Mana regeneration.

improved_drains.name: Improved Drains
improved_drains.text: Increases health drained or damage done by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by {0}%.

improved_bane_of_agony.name: Improved Bane of Agony
improved_bane_of_agony.text: Increases the damage done by your Bane of Agony by {0}%.

fel_concentration.name: Fel Concentration
fel_concentration.text: Gives you a {0}% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling or casting your Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul, or Wrack spells.

amplify_curse.name: Amplify Curse
amplify_curse.text: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

pandemic.name: Pandemic
pandemic.text: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by {0}%.

malevolence.name: Malevolence
malevolence.text: Increases the critical effect chance of your Shadow spells by {0}%.

nightfall.name: Nightfall
nightfall.text: Gives your Corruption, Drain Soul, Drain Life, and Wrack spells a {0}% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by {1}%.

curse_of_exhaustion.name: Curse of Exhaustion
curse_of_exhaustion.text: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

siphon_life.name: Siphon Life
siphon_life.text: Transfers 11 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.

soul_siphon.name: Soul Siphon
soul_siphon.text: Increases the damage done or health drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by {0}% per each of your other Affliction effects active on the target, up to a maximum increase of {1}%.

shadow_mastery.name: Shadow Mastery
shadow_mastery.text: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by {0}%.

wrack.name: Wrack
wrack.text: Tears the target apart from within, dealing 36 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by 10%. Lasts 6 sec.

improved_health_funnel.name: Improved Health Funnel
improved_health_funnel.text: Increases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by {0}%, reduces its health cost by {1}%, and reduces all threat your Health Funnel generates by {2}%. Allows Health Funnel to be used regardless of your demon's health.

improved_imp.name: Improved Imp
improved_imp.text: Increases the damage of your Imp's Firebolt spell by {0}% and the effect of its Fire Shield spell by {1}%.

unholy_power.name: Unholy Power
unholy_power.text: Increases all damage done by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter pets by {0}%.

demonic_aegis.name: Demonic Aegis
demonic_aegis.text: Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Skin and Demon Armor spells by {0}%.

improved_voidwalker.name: Improved Voidwalker
improved_voidwalker.text: Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice, and Suffering spells by {0}%.

fel_vitality.name: Fel Vitality
fel_vitality.text: Increases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by {0}%, and increases your maximum Mana by {1}%.

demonic_energies.name: Demonic Energies
demonic_energies.text: You heal your pet for {0}% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains {1}% of the Mana you gain.

improved_sayaad.name: Improved Sayaad
improved_sayaad.text: Increases the effect of your Succubus' and Incubus' Lash of Pain and Soothing Kiss spells by {0}%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' and Incubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by {1}%.

demonic_sacrifice.name: Demonic Sacrifice
demonic_sacrifice.text:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 2 hrs. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%.

Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec.

Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.

Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

master_summoner.name: Master Summoner
master_summoner.text: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter Summoning spells by {0} sec and the Mana cost by {1}%.

decimation.name: Decimation
decimation.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Soul Fire spell by {0}%. When you cast Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on an enemy below {1}% health, they deal {2}% increased damage, and for the next {3} sec your Soul Fire spell has its cast time reduced by {4}% and costs no Soul Shards.

fel_domination.name: Fel Domination
fel_domination.text: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

demonic_brand.name: Demonic Brand
demonic_brand.text: Your Searing Pain generates {0}% less threat and brands the target for {1} sec. Your pet's next {2} attacks against the target generate high threat and deal {3} to {4} Fire or Shadow damage based on the pet.

improved_felhunter.name: Improved Felhunter
improved_felhunter.text: Increases the Attack Power reduction of your Felhunter's Tainted Blood, the healing of its Devour Magic, and the detection level of its Paranoia by {0}%, and reduces the cooldown of its Spell Lock by {1} sec.

soul_link.name: Soul Link
soul_link.text: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

demonic_knowledge.name: Demonic Knowledge
demonic_knowledge.text: Increases your spell damage and your Demon pet's spell damage by up to {0}% of your level while you have a summoned Demon pet active.

master_demonologist.name: Master Demonologist
master_demonologist.text:
Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active.

Imp - Increases Fire damage done by {0}%.

Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by {1}%.

Succubus/Incubus - Increases Shadow damage done by {2}%.

Felhunter - Reduces Magic damage taken by {3}%.

demonic_pact.name: Demonic Pact
demonic_pact.text: Your Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect.

destructive_reach.name: Destructive Reach
destructive_reach.text: Increases the range of your damaging spells by {0}%.

improved_shadow_bolt.name: Improved Shadow Bolt
improved_shadow_bolt.text: Your Shadow Bolt critical strikes increase Shadow damage taken by the target from your attacks by {0}% for {1} sec.

bane.name: Bane
bane.text: Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate spells by {0} sec and your Soul Fire spell by {1} sec.

cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
cataclysm.text: Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by {0}%.

aftermath.name: Aftermath
aftermath.text: Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by {0}% and your Conflagrate spell has a {1}% chance to Daze the target, reducing the target's movement speed by {2}% for {3} sec.

ruin.name: Ruin
ruin.text: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by {0}%.

shadowburn.name: Shadowburn
shadowburn.text: Instantly blasts the target for 65 to 73 Shadow damage. If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

intensity.name: Intensity
intensity.text: Gives you a {0}% chance to resist interruption caused by damage while casting or channeling any Destruction spell.

agonizing_flames.name: Agonizing Flames
agonizing_flames.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by {0}% and the damage done by all your Destruction spells by {1}%.

conflagrate.name: Conflagrate
conflagrate.text: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 88 to 110 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.

pyroclasm.name: Pyroclasm
pyroclasm.text: Gives your Soul Fire spell a {0}% chance to Stun the target for {1} sec, and your Rain of Fire and Hellfire spells a {2}% chance over their duration to Stun targets they damage for {3} sec.

bane_of_havoc.name: Bane of Havoc
bane_of_havoc.text: Afflicts the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

fire_and_brimstone.name: Fire and Brimstone
fire_and_brimstone.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Conflagrate spell by {0}%.

shadow_and_flame.name: Shadow and Flame
shadow_and_flame.text: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by {0}% for {1} sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by {2}% for {3} sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a {4}% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a {5}% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.

incinerate.name: Incinerate
incinerate.text: Deals 99 to 113 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.
